reject_substitutes: a mesh pattern printed on opaque fabric
a smooth sheer panel without visible mesh
a fishnet backdrop behind the subject

hard_gates.criterion: The right hand belongs to the standing adult subject and the left arm remains at her hip; each is explicitly assigned.
A shoulder-height knob beside her can be reached by a bent arm without twisting the front-facing torso; the lamp stays outside the abdominal sightline.
The subject stands upright on a level floor. Her hidden lower legs continue under her pelvis; no second load or unstable prop support is demanded.
The operative hand contacts the exterior brass tilt knob on a side yoke. The lamp is beside rather than in front of the abdomen, leaving space for the mesh panel.

Almost frontal head-to-upper-thigh framing includes the face, complete abdominal panel and waistband. The pose keeps the arm and lamp out of that panel; mesh is over skin rather than substituted for a void.

supplemental_target_gates.expected: Real fine mesh threads and open cells over abdominal skin, bounded by opaque bodice hem above and opaque trouser waistband below.
A readable small anatomical navel depression through the mesh, below the upper hem and above the trouser waistband; no jewel, hole in cloth or painted dot substitute.
Continuous opaque fitted bodice covering bust and opaque trousers beside the transparent panel.
Clearly adult fashion subject; visible short dark bob, airy bangs and broad facial appearance guidance from portrait; no identity inference.
Right hand contacts brass tilt knob on side yoke; lamp is on a stand beside subject; body supported by level floor.
Complete face and relevant mesh panel and navel visible at native scale; hands and lamp do not occlude panel.
